name: Authority Mailer SMTP – Professional Email Delivery & SMTP Configuration Plugin for WordPress
author: Authority Plugins

sections.description:
Authority Mailer SMTP is the professional email delivery solution for WordPress. It replaces the unreliable default wp_mail() function with enterprise-grade SMTP providers, ensuring your emails reach users’ inboxes reliably.

Why Better Email Delivery Matters

WordPress’s default mail function often fails because:
* Server blacklisting – Shared hosting servers get blacklisted by ISPs
* Silent failures – Emails disappear without notification or error tracking
* Spam folder delivery – Missing DKIM/SPF authentication
* No visibility – Can’t track which emails succeeded or failed

Authority Mailer SMTP solves these problems with professional infrastructure, delivery tracking, and authentication protocols.

Key Features

  • 17+ Email Providers – SendGrid, Mailgun, Brevo, Amazon SES, Gmail, Postmark, MailerSend, Mailjet, Mandrill, Office 365, Zoho, SMTP2GO, SparkPost, Elastic Email, and more
  • Easy Setup Wizard – Step-by-step configuration with no technical knowledge required
  • Email Logging – Track every email sent, monitor delivery status, debug failures
  • Test Emails – Verify configuration before going live
  • OAuth2 Support – Secure Gmail and Office 365 authentication without storing passwords
  • Custom SMTP – Use your own mail server or ISP SMTP
  • Search & Export – Find specific emails by recipient, subject, or date
  • Enterprise Security – Encrypted credential storage, HTTPS/TLS encryption, GDPR compliant

Supported Email Providers

For High Volume:
* SendGrid – Industry leader, 99.99% uptime SLA
* Mailgun – Developer-friendly, flexible pricing
* Amazon SES – Ultra-affordable at scale ($0.10/1000 emails)

For Budget-Conscious Sites:
* Brevo – Free tier with 300 emails/day
* Gmail API – Free with your Gmail account
* SMTP2GO – Simple, reliable service

For Enterprise:
* Office 365/Microsoft 365 – Enterprise security, HIPAA/FINRA compliant
* Postmark – Transactional specialists, zero-bounce guarantee
* MailerSend – GDPR-compliant European option

Plus: Mailjet, Mandrill, Elastic Email, Zoho Mail, SparkPost, SendLayer, SMTP. com, and custom SMTP servers.

Perfect For

✅ E-commerce – Order confirmations, shipping notifications, refunds
✅ Membership Sites – Welcome emails, password resets, renewals
✅ WordPress Communities – User registration, notifications
✅ WooCommerce – Automated store emails
✅ Online Courses – Lesson notifications, certificates
✅ Agencies – Client notifications, project updates
✅ SaaS Platforms – User onboarding, alerts, reports
✅ Healthcare – Patient notifications (HIPAA-compatible)
✅ Nonprofits – Donation receipts, campaigns

How It Works

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Go to Authority Mailer SMTP → Setup Wizard
  3. Choose your email provider and enter credentials
  4. Send a test email to verify configuration
  5. Done! All WordPress emails now route through your provider

Security & Privacy

  • API keys stored encrypted in WordPress database
  • Credentials never sent to third-party servers
  • HTTPS/TLS encryption for all connections
  • GDPR, CCPA, and HIPAA compatible
  • OAuth2 for Gmail and Office 365 (passwords never stored)
  • Email data only sent to your chosen provider
  • No data sent to Authority Mailer servers

Premium Support

This plugin is free with all core features included. Premium support and advanced features are available at https://yoursite.com/support.

External Services

This plugin connects to external email services you choose during setup. Data is only sent to providers you explicitly configure.

sections.installation:
Automatic Installation:
1. Log in to WordPress admin panel
2. Go to Plugins > Add New
3. Search “Authority Mailer SMTP”
4. Click Install Now, then Activate

Manual Installation:
1. Download the plugin ZIP file
2. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
3. Select the ZIP file and click Install Now
4. Click Activate

After Installation:
1. Go to Authority Mailer SMTP in the admin menu
2. Click Setup Wizard
3. Choose your email provider
4. Enter your API credentials
5. Send a test email to verify setup
sections.faq:
Which email provider should I use?

  • Budget: Brevo (free tier) or Gmail API
  • Reliability: Postmark or SendGrid
  • Flexibility: Mailgun
  • High Volume: Amazon SES
  • Enterprise: SendGrid or Office 365

Is my email data secure?

Yes. API keys are encrypted in your WordPress database, never shared, and only sent to your chosen provider. All connections use HTTPS/TLS encryption.

Can I switch providers later?

Yes. Go to settings, choose a new provider, and future emails use the new one. Historical logs remain with the original provider.

Will this work with my plugins?

Yes! All plugins using WordPress’s wp_mail() function automatically use your configured provider, including WooCommerce, contact forms, and membership plugins.

Can I use my own SMTP server?

Yes. Select “Custom SMTP” in the setup wizard and enter your server details.

Can I see email delivery status?

Yes! Email logs show delivery status, error messages, recipient, subject, timestamp, and provider response.

How many emails can I send?

Depends on your provider. Brevo’s free tier allows 300/day. Paid plans typically support unlimited volume.

Is there a free version?

Yes! All core features are free. Premium support and advanced features are available as commercial add-ons.
